scope: Broaden the open-source implementation review to include a newly surfaced libdxfrw-derived fork, current consumer test-lane structure, route-specific DWG/DXF fuzzing, and strict-versus-recovery DXF reads; refine implementation readiness without introducing a local defect or promoting support claims.

method.kind: Public primary repositories and project documentation
method.evidenceBoundary: Default-branch documentation and repository pages are a research snapshot, not reproducible runtime evidence. No exact source revision or artifact was captured for the codelibs fork. No external corpus bytes were inspected or admitted. Results refine comparator lineage and test cadence only.

evidence.topic: codelibs/libdxfrw correlated fork and test discovery value
evidence.observed: The repository describes itself as a fork of the original libdxfrw, advertises ASCII/binary DXF read/write and DWG reading from R14 through V2015, lists version/entity/error test executables, and explicitly states DWG writing is unsupported with limited entity coverage. The README points to an external fess-testdata corpus.
doesNotEstablish: independence from libdxfrw or LibreCAD's bundled lineage
that advertised version/entity routes pass on current source
DWG writing, complete object graph/opaque preservation, or 3D semantics
permission to copy, redistribute, or commit external test corpus bytes
evidence.planUse: Classify as CORRELATED_FORK / DISCOVERY_ONLY. Use its test names only as scenario-discovery hints; rederive any selected vector from the authoritative format specification or a local in-memory builder. Do not add a dependency, fixture, required peer run, or independent evidence vote.

evidence.observed: The current consumer CMake defines separately named fast and slow libdxfrw test source families/executables and separately gates format/full test registration. The consumer repository vendors its own libdxfrw fork, so these are compatibility and test-organization references rather than independent parser evidence.
doesNotEstablish: that a LibreCAD test is exercising this standalone checkout
that the full application suite should run for every implementation slice
evidence.planUse: Retain test extraction in staged waves. Every implementation slice should name the touched strict build target and nearest focused test; run consumer-fork tests only as explicit compatibility checks. Keep slow/full tests at planned composed checkpoints.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG route-specific fuzzing and class dispositions
evidence.observed: LibreDWG documents distinct fuzzing paths and class-level stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled statuses. Its 0.14.1 notes enumerate parser, writer, ownership, DXF, and decompression regressions, confirming the value of associating a result with a specific route and family.
doesNotEstablish: that peer fuzz throughput or corpus should become a per-slice requirement
evidence.planUse: Keep route/family outcome categories explicit and use exact route-specific fast controls. Continue the existing scheduled fuzz/sanitizer cadence; do not import peer repro bytes, increase full-suite frequency, or copy peer fixes without local source/spec evidence.

evidence.topic: ezdxf ordinary versus recovery read boundary
evidence.observed: The project directs ordinary reads at well-formed/trusted DXF and identifies a separate recover module for structurally flawed drawings; its CLI can audit and save a recovered drawing.
doesNotEstablish: that recovery preserves the original byte stream or all source semantics
a clean strict parse of a repaired/resaved file
evidence.planUse: Keep strict ordinary parse/readback as the acceptance path. Recovery, repair diagnostics, and re-saved outputs stay a separate diagnostic lane and cannot count as clean interoperability evidence. This reinforces existing PAR-14/PAR-15 owners without adding a finding.

perSlice: build only the touched production/test targets with the strict warning policy
run the nearest focused route-specific test and required API compatibility compile
check the exact diff; do not run the full suite or long fuzz campaign routinely
composedOrScheduled: full/family suites after related slices compose
ASan/UBSan and longer route-separated fuzz campaigns at security checkpoints
pinned peer and native CAD runs at named composed qualification checkpoints
peerEvidenceFields: decoded, preserved/opaque, skipped, rejected, and errored outcomes
whether the consumer links the standalone library or a bundled fork
strict versus recovery mode and repair diagnostics
